## Research

```{=html}
<div class="ab-cards two">
  <div class="ab-card">
    <i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i>
    <h3>Port-Hamiltonian systems</h3>
    <p>Energy-based, modular modelling of continuum mechanics and multiphysics.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ab-card">
    <i class="bi bi-bounding-box"></i>
    <h3>Structure-preserving discretization</h3>
    <p>Finite element exterior calculus, mixed and hybrid methods, energy-conserving integrators.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ab-card">
    <i class="bi bi-sliders"></i>
    <h3>Control meets numerics</h3>
    <p>Systems theory as a lens on numerical fluxes and domain decomposition.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ab-card">
    <i class="bi bi-soundwave"></i>
    <h3>High-frequency vibrations</h3>
    <p>Methods beyond classical finite elements for wave propagation in solids.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
